text:
Your eyes looked at me

and in a beautiful east,

showed me a star

resplendent.

Your beautiful lip repaid

my submissive love,

and the star was a gleam

of paradise.


But in vain you kindled

my pleasant longing,

and brought down to earth

the light of heaven,

if soon you have extinguished

my beloved sun

and in shadows has left me

your frozen oblivion.

translation.title: Your Eyes Looked at Me...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the songlike quatrain movement and the final darkening of the beloved sun.
